title: CleanTab managed configuration
description: Values an administrator sets by policy. Anything set here is authoritative and read-only in the extension UI; anything left unset stays the user's own choice.

sensitivity.title: Detection sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Which threshold profile to lock. Strict blocks on weaker signals and produces more false positives.

enableDwellDetection.title: Image scanning
enableDwellDetection.description: Classify images the user lingers on. Runs locally; costs battery.

allowDisable.title: Allow the user to disable protection
allowDisable.description: Set false to remove the off switch entirely. The per-page escape hatches are governed separately and should normally stay available.

allowAppeals.title: Allow 'This site is fine'
allowAppeals.description: Set false to stop the user granting a site permanent trust from the pause screen. 'Let me through once' is unaffected.

allowTrustSites.title: Allow the user to add trusted sites
allowTrustSites.description: Set false to make the trust list read-only in the popup.

lockedTrustedSites.title: Administrator trust list
lockedTrustedSites.description: Domains that are always trusted and cannot be removed by the user.
